snippet.title: Legion | Expansion Highlights
snippet.description:
EVE Online's Legion expansion brings transformative power to New Eden! Introducing two formidable new ships and freelancing to help corporations grow while giving new capsuleers meaningful ways to connect and contribute through player-created missions. Legion also brings three new sovereignty upgrades, a suite of balance changes, and much more.

Whether you're a seasoned veteran or new to the universe, Legion offers unparalleled opportunities to energize your next chapter among the stars.
